order: Correct the P0 Quartermaster's DEFAULT review-draw forecast (ruling R4). The prior derivation sustained the PEAK arrival rate across a full 168h week to reach mandatoryReviewDraw = 0.504, pushing the default requiredReserve to ~0.6552, so the P15 gate fired on nearly any bucket. That fabricates load: no week runs entirely at burst rate. Replace the default with the directly MEASURED weekly draw (0.03); leave incidentDraw at 0 as a disclosed under-estimate; preserve the rejected peak-derived arithmetic in the comments as the cautionary alternative. 0.03 x 1.3 = 0.039 sits below the plan's own 8% floor, so the floor governs. IN SCOPE, and nothing else: defaultForecast() and its ruling-R4 comment block; the README's R4 section; the pinned R4 test values plus a check that the floor governs. Constraint: every other behaviour of the seat — the override path, the freshness rules, the fail-closed refusals, the confirmation protocol, the throttle-prediction method and the report output — must be left exactly as it is.
claims: defaultForecast() now returns the measured 0.03 draw, and the rejected peak-derived arithmetic (0.504, ~0.6552) is preserved in the comments as the cautionary alternative, computed but unused. The README's R4 section records both derivations and notes the override path is unaffected. Pinned values updated (0.504 -> 0.03, 0.6552 -> the 0.08 floor), with an explicit check that the floor, not the 0.039 dynamic term, governs the default. Verified: node tests/quartermaster.test.js — 154 passed; node tests/router.test.js — 135 passed.
